$description: Design tokens for the frontend of the official Nyxis sample (bulletin board). Paper (background) and ink (text, rules, buttons), plus vermilion (stamps, admin) and green (done, published). The implementation maps them to CSS variables (--color-paper and so on). Dark mode is optional.

paper.$description: Page background. A grayish off-white with no yellow tint

ink.$description: Text, rules, primary buttons, person mark

ink-2.$description: Body excerpts and the text of subdued buttons

ink-3.$description: Numbers, IDs, small headings, unselected menu items. 4.9:1 on the background

rule-strong.$description: Thick rule (3px). Below the header and along the top edge of a sheet

silhouette.$description: Silhouette of an unreadable body, and loading

vermilion.$description: Vermilion. The Can't view / Not allowed stamps, delete, admin, the wordmark square. 5.6:1 on white

green.$description: Green. The Published tag, success stamps, the ○ in What you can do. 5.3:1 on white

amber.$description: Amber. The Check your input underline and the Not registered outline

amber-text.$description: The sentence below the amber underline. 5.5:1 on the pale amber background

amber-tint.$description: Background of a field in the Check your input state

toast-ok.$description: The check mark inside the black notification

sans.$value: "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Hiragino Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
sans.$description: All text and UI. Self-hosted with next/font

mono.$description: Only IDs, numbers, and the contents of "Details"

xs.$description: Tags, small headings (letter spacing .1em), ID line

md.$description: Body excerpts, person mark text, subdued buttons

lg.$description: List titles, the sentence below a stamp

xl.$description: Title input on New post / Edit, stamps

5.$description: Left and right margin of the content (full width)

8.$description: Sheet padding (left and right), below headings

sm.$description: Buttons, black band, dashed box, vermilion box

rule-strong.$description: Below the header, top edge of a sheet, selected menu item

stamp.$description: Double line with 3px of white and 1px of the same color inside (box-shadow inset)

touch.$description: Minimum height of buttons, menu items, and inputs

stack.$description: Below this, the header wraps to two rows, button rows stack vertically, and What you can do uses two columns

stamp-in.$description: The stamp is pressed in from a slightly larger size. 0 under prefers-reduced-motion
